ticket.subject: Export to Excel format
ticket.body_text:
Hi there!

Could you add an export to XLSX next to the CSV export?

Dates also turn into text when we open the CSV files. Our finance team re-formats every CSV by hand.

It would save us a lot of time.

Thanks so much!
Chloe Tanabe
engineering manager, Hollowfen Media
